basics.name: Francesco Cancelliere
basics.label: Robotics Research Engineer
basics.summary: PhD candidate specializing in AI Robot Navigation in Unstructured Environments with extensive experience in Deep Reinforcement Learning, edge AI deployment, and full-stack robotic system development.

work.name: RobotiXX George Mason University
work.summary: Focusing on autonomous outdoor navigation and hardware optimization for off-road platforms.
highlights: Designed and built improved version of an RC-scale robot for autonomous outdoor navigation
Reduced the center of gravity by 20%, improving off-road capabilities and stability
Refactored the software stack from ROS to ROS 2, ensuring compatibility with the latest navigation software stack
Developed C++ embedded software for an off-road differential-drive platform via micro-ROS on a Teensy 4.0 MCU

work.name: Deepsensing S.r.l.
work.summary: Supervising vision models development and edge platform benchmarking.
highlights: Supervise vision models development for NVIDIA Jetson, Hailo-8, and Intel ARRIA 10
Conduct performance benchmarking and testing to evaluate hardware efficiency

work.name: Faradex S.r.l.
work.summary: Specializing in low-level firmware and ultra-low power RTOS solutions.
highlights: Accelerated time-to-market for 5+ products using FreeRTOS on STM32 and ESP32 platforms
Focused on ultra-low power applications with sub mAh consumption

work.name: Rosys Group University of Catania
work.summary: Led the development of the autonomous beach cleanup system (SandRo).
highlights: Delivered a full-stack robotic solution from proof-of-concept to field testing in 6 months
Engineered high-level perception stack using YOLOv5 and MoveIt with a UR10e arm
